title: Lava Particles | More
description: An immersive client-side mod that brings Minecraft lava to life with custom boiling bubbles, more!
body:
# 🔥 Lava Particles | More **A simple client-side mod that makes Minecraft lava look and sound alive.** [![Minecraft Versions](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.20.1%20%7C%201.21.1-1f8b4c?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/lavalive) [![Loaders](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loaders-Fabric%20%7C%20Forge%20%7C%20NeoForge-df5926?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/lavalive) [![Side](https://img.shields.io/badge/Side-Client--Only-important?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/lavalive) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-LGPL--3.0--only-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/lavalive) --- **Lava Particles | More** is a client-side mod that completely changes how Minecraft lava feels. It adds dynamic bubbles, sizzling effects, volcanic geysers, and splash physics to make caves and the Nether look much more immersive.
--- ## ✨ Features ### 🌋 Lava Geysers & Eruptions * **Magma Geysers**: Large lava pools occasionally erupt with rising columns of heat-distortion waves, bubbles, and hot flying droplets. * **Ambient Sounds**: Eruptions are accompanied by deep, low-frequency volcanic rumbling. ### 🫧 Bubbling Effects * **Surface Bubbles**: Lava pools bubble actively with tiny fizzing pops on the surface. * **Deep Magma Bubbles**: Large magma bubbles rise slowly from the depths of lava lakes and burst at the surface. ### ☄️ Splash & Droplet Physics * **Landing Droplets**: Flying magma drops land on blocks, slide around, and slowly cool down (changing color from bright red to dark basalt) before disappearing. * **Water Interactions**: Droplets fizz and sizzle when landing in water, creating steam and rising water bubbles. * **Droplet Damage (Optional)**: Magma drops can deal minor fire damage (`0.5 hearts`) to players, with a customizable cooldown. ### 💨 Realistic Combustion * **Lava Sizzling**: Submerging or walking in lava creates dense columns of smoke, sparks, bubbling, and constant sizzling sound effects. --- ## 🛠️ Installation & Compatibility > [!NOTE] > **This mod is purely client-side!** You do not need to install it on servers to enjoy the visual atmospheric improvements in multiplayer. * **Supported Loaders**: Fabric, Forge, NeoForge * **Supported Versions**: Minecraft `1.20.1` & `1.21.1` * **Dependencies**: - **Fabric**: Requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) for configuration GUI. - **Forge / NeoForge**: Requires [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config). --- ## ⚙️ Configuration Options You can customize everything in-game using the configuration menu: | Tab | Option Name | Description | Default Value | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Visuals** | **Check Frequencies** | Adjust update rates to optimize performance. | `1.0` | | | **Particle Spawn Multipliers** | Control the density of lava and smoke particles. | `1.0` | | | **Overworld Activity Multipliers** | Adjust eruption frequency outside the Nether. | `0.5` | | | **Magma Floor Stay Time** | How long droplets stay on the ground before cooling down. | `3.0s` | | | **Large Bubble Toggles** | Enable or disable large bubbling effects. | `true` | | **Audio** | **Mod Volume Multiplier** | Master volume control for custom sounds. | `1.0` | | | **Pop Sound Toggle** | Toggle the sound of small bursting bubbles. | `true` | | | **Rumble Sound Toggle** | Toggle deep volcanic rumbles. | `true` | | **Gameplay** | **Player Lava Sizzling** | Toggle steam and sizzling effects when in lava. | `true` | | | **Droplet Fire Damage** | Toggle whether magma droplets deal minor fire damage. | `true` | | | **Damage Cooldown** | Cooldown time between droplet damage ticks. | `3.0s` | --- ## 📄 License & Modpacks Distributed under the **GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (LGPL-3.0-only)**. **Modpacks**: You are free to include this mod in any public or private modpack! Please credit **stepqq** as the author.
